question: Ruslan's regulator step in mammals: does promoter motif enrichment in his gene sets, measured in each species' own genome, change with adult mass, and does it replicate across panels?
genomes: NCBI RefSeq/annotated assemblies per species (config/genomes.tsv); species without an annotated genome are excluded; Saimiri sciureus uses Saimiri boliviensis and is flagged as congener
genes: per panel, the fixed-composition background of step 1, restricted to symbols that occur exactly once as a protein-coding gene name in that species' annotation
promoter: -1000/+200 nt around the TSS of the longest annotated mRNA of the gene, strand-aware (minus-strand windows reverse-complemented), soft-masked bases kept
motifs: size_program_regulons_2026-10-21_v1/reference/JASPAR2024_one_per_symbol.meme; FIMO p <= 1e-4 both strands; gene positive if at least one site
background: all other genes of the panel background in that species (complements computed on the same gene identifiers, fixing the Fisher-complement defect of the bird code)
enrichment: per species x set x motif: log odds ratio (Haldane +0.5) of motif-positive genes, foreground vs background, Mantel-Haenszel across GC-content quintiles of the promoter windows
mass_test: per panel x set x motif: PGLS of log OR on log10 adult mass with the step-1 covariance restricted to species with genomes; Pearson r reported
multiple_testing: BH over all panel x set x motif tests
replication: same sign and PGLS p < 0.05 in at least two panels; a candidate regulator also requires its own RNA detected in the fibroblast panels
replication_null: 1000 draws of phylogenetically simulated log mass per panel (multivariate normal with the panel covariance, scaled to the observed variance), recomputing the number of replicated set x motif pairs; empirical p of the observed count
not_done: Ruslan's enhancer windows (no mammalian fibroblast enhancer maps for these species) and CellOracle virtual knockouts
